phase.goal: PHASE 1 — INTELLIGENCE, BUSINESS FOUNDATION, TRUST ARCHITECTURE, AND PREMIUM EXPERIENCE

milestone.description: Repository/project foundation, durable multi-tenant state, provider abstraction

completed: P1-01: Repo/app foundation (Next.js 16 App Router, strict TypeScript, Tailwind 4, ESLint, Prettier, Vitest, Playwright, Prisma 7 + Postgres via Docker, env validation, deterministic health check)
P1-02: Data layer — User/Session/Organization/Membership/Project schema + migration, password hashing, session lifecycle, tenant-aware authorization, tenant-isolation integration tests
P1-03: Canonical Product State, Product DNA, Product Memory, Product Knowledge relationships, all project-scoped and tenant-isolated
P1-04: AI provider abstraction, Intent Resolver, Impact Analysis foundation, product-facing Decision Ledger, Orchestration Contract change-flow skeleton
P1-05: Platform-wide versioned Supported Capability Registry mirroring Master Spec §4.3, seeded truthfully, and a Feasibility Engine
P1-06: Requirements Engine, Business Model Brief + monetization recommendations, unit-economics assumptions, generateProductIntelligence wired into beginChangeFlow

P1-07: Product-facing Event Ledger, Evidence Ledger, and Truth Status, mapped conservatively from platform capability level to per-project status, wired into generateProductIntelligence and the Decision Ledger

P1-08: Integration Requirements tracking (upsert-by-category, Master Spec §30), AES-256-GCM credential vault (fresh IV per call, tamper-detected via GCM auth tag, narrow plaintext accessor separate from broadly-safe metadata), Governance Profile (one mutable profile per project, §32), and versioned Policy Document scaffolding per (type, language) (§34)

testStatus.unit: pass (44/44: env 4, slug 4, mock-provider 4, anthropic-provider 1, impact-analysis 6, requirements-engine 10, business-intelligence 7, unit-economics 3, crypto 5)
testStatus.integration: pass (101/101: users 5, session 5, tenancy 7, product-state 5, product-dna 6, product-memory 4, product-knowledge 5, decisions 7, intent-resolver 3, change-flow 3, capability-registry 5, seed-data 3, feasibility 5, product-intelligence 6, events 3, evidence 3, truth-status 4, truth-status-sync 4, vault 6, governance-profile 4, integrations 3, policy-documents 5)

knownLimitations: Everything through P1-08 exists only as a service/library layer — no UI, no Server Actions, no HTTP routes wire it up yet. That is P1-10/P1-11.
Tenant isolation is proven at the service+authz layer against a real database, not yet at the HTTP boundary (no routes exist to attack yet).
No real integration provider (Stripe etc.) is connected — the credential vault is proven correct in isolation but has no live caller until Phase 2/3 wire an actual provider connection flow.
Policy documents are durable/versioned but not yet generated from real Product State content (generation itself is optional per §34, not required in Phase 1).
AI provider is mock-only; Requirements Engine, Business Model Brief, and unit economics are deterministic/template-based, not real product or market intelligence.
Phase 1's own customer flow (§51) never requires an edit; full conversational editing is Phase 2 scope (§55, §57).
No billing/entitlement architecture yet — P1-09, next.
No automated e2e (Playwright) coverage yet — nothing customer-facing exists to test end-to-end.
nextAction: Begin P1-09: plans, entitlements, and billing-state architecture (Master Spec §36-37) using mock/test state only — live Pocket Studio billing is explicitly Phase 3 scope (§62).
